paragraphs.text: The self-proclaimed Master Hunter Chevill is a Human Rogue of Ikoria . He is considered the plane's most accomplished monster hunter.

Chevill isn't a particularly tall man, but his shoulders are broad and densely packed with muscle. His hair is swept back behind a high forehead and he wears a prominent mustache. He is an arrogant but very skilled big-game hunter . He spends most of his time slogging through the wetlands of Zagoth as if he owns them. He's an expert at replicating the calls of certain animals, which he uses to draw large-antlered alphas away from their herd.
The planeswalker Vivien Reid strongly despises him; according to her, Chevill is the worst kind of human.

Vivien Reid once found Chevill in a Drannith tavern. After hearing Chevill's claims to be the best monster hunter of Ikoria, Vivien started a bar fight, at the end of which she managed to knock him out.

During the the New Phyrexian Invasion , Chevill and his hunter group were enlisted to defend Ikoria against the compleated Lukka after the destruction of Drannith, much to the distaste of Vivien. While snide at her need of his assistance, his bravado faltered once Lukka's monstrosity scattered their forces, and Chevill retreated.
